title: Circular Scalp Massage
summary: The finger pads gently move the scalp in small circles.
instructions: Place the finger pads on the scalp.
Make small circles that move with the skin.
Do not scratch with the nails.
warning: Do not massage damaged or inflamed skin. Stop with dizziness, worsening headache, pain, or other unusual symptoms.
